name: promptfu
description: Rewrites prompts to fit the model that will run them (Claude, GPT and Codex, Gemini, and image, video and deep-research products), detects the model in use in Claude Code or Codex, picks the model and effort within that vendor, and shapes the prompt to the task type. Auto-fires on subagent dispatch and long prompts. Kill switch: PROMPTFU_DISABLE env var, or a project .promptfu file with `off`.
